title: London road disruptions (TfL)
what: Works, incidents and closures on London's roads as TfL lists them: severity, category, place, TfL's description and the period.

schedule.how: once a day at data.b@'s morning wake: one GET of api.tfl.gov.uk/Road/all/Disruption, no key; the page reads it live in the browser

terms.quote: You are free to: Copy, publish, distribute and transmit the Information; Adapt the Information and Exploit the Information commercially and non-commercially
